story.originalTitle: LMGT3 Teams' Trophy points system updated for 2027 👀 Results from both cars will count towards a single LMGT3 Teams' classification next year. Curr...
story.summaryEn:
LMGT3 Teams' Trophy points system updated for 2027 👀
Results from both cars will count towards a single LMGT3 Teams' classification next year. Currently, each car in a two-car team scores points independently as a separate entry. The revised format places greater emphasis on overall team performance.
#FIA #WEC
detailZh:
LMGT3车队奖杯积分系统更新至2027年👀
明年，两辆车的成绩将计入单一LMGT3车队分类。目前，两车队的每辆车都作为独立参赛者独立计分。修订后的格式更加重视整体车队表现。
#FIA #WEC

LMGT3 Teams' Trophy points system updated for 2027 👀
